headline: 笑匠狗狗秀暖心開演
context: 《The Whisper Man》是 Netflix 新片，評論認為勞勃．狄尼洛的演出敷衍了事，劇情也是老套的連環殺手片。相對地，愛丁堡藝穗節上，喜劇演員 Spencer Jones 以狗為主題的個人秀，反而被評論形容為溫暖動人。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: A father and son must team up to find a serial killer in a cheaply made and increasingly uninteresting thriller It’s not as if Robert De Niro ’s choices have improved all that much since the nadir of the mid-2000s (last year did see him crop up in a Scott Eastwood-led actioner and The Alto Knights ) but there’s something specifically rubbishy about his latest that transports us back to that particularly cursed time. The Whisper Man, a film as openly stupid as its title would suggest, could have been released in between the evil clone horror Godsend and imaginary friend thriller Hide and Seek , the kind of bottom-tier project that offers the actor a nice big cheque and the audience a nice little nap. It’s a familiar pile of B-movie schlock – serial killers, missing children, bumps in the night, more imaginary friends – and there is some initial junky fun to be had as we wonder just where it all might be headed. I was hoping for a destination a little more deranged or vaguely surprising, the film making a silent promise that we’re hurtling toward somewhere wildly unexpected before dumping us in a ditch instead. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Pleasance Dome, Edinburgh Behind this grab-bag of papier-mache heads and walkies banter lies a celebration of simply talking to one another First came Ricky Gervais’s cynical cats ; now here are Spencer Jones’s optimistic Dogs. One was tawdry, the other couldn’t be sweeter, as the prop-comic delivers this hymn to the canine-human relationship. Like much of Jones’s work , it’s a grab-bag, as he circles seemingly at random between character comedy in papier-mache heads, loop-pedal nonsense and dopey dog-walking business with an animatronic mutt. Not all of it is dog-related. And yet, it adds up to something winning, as Jones leads his four-legged friends towards a closing message about social cohesion in acrimonious times – and how our pets can help. It begins as a chat with the audience about their animals, with Jones poshing it up in character as a snobby dog-walker. One strand of the show, taking as its motto the question “Aren’t humans weird?”, functions as a gleeful anthropology of dog owners. They carry bags of poo by their sides. They lose control of their hounds, and in that panic reveal their true selves. Their armoury includes something resembling a ladle – cueing, apropos of nothing, a very funny sequence in which Jones, in horsey false teeth, samples soup supposedly cooked by his audience. 🧵 1/N
📌 八大藝術

Netflix新片評價不佳　勞勃．狄尼洛敷衍演出

Netflix 新片《The Whisper Man》被評論批評劇情老套，勞勃．狄尼洛的演出也顯得意興闌珊，講述一對父子聯手尋找連環殺手的故事。

相對地，愛丁堡藝穗節上，喜劇演員 Spencer Jones 以狗為主題的個人秀，被評論形容為溫暖動人，最後導向一個關於社會凝聚的訊息。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月 28 日至 29 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
Netflix 新片《The Whisper Man》被評論批評劇情老套，勞勃．狄尼洛的演出也顯得意興闌珊，講述一對父子聯手尋找連環殺手的故事，被形容成廉價的 B 級驚悚片。

相對地，愛丁堡藝穗節上，喜劇演員 Spencer Jones 以狗為主題的個人秀，被評論形容為溫暖動人。表演從跟觀眾聊他們養的狗開始，最後導向一個關於社會凝聚的訊息——寵物如何幫我們在紛擾的時代裡，好好跟彼此說話。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 28 日至 29 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 有一部片評價不太好。Netflix 新片《The Whisper Man》，講一對父子聯手尋找連環殺手，評論說勞勃．狄尼洛的演出意興闌珊，劇情也是老套的 B 級驚悚片路數。反差比較大的是愛丁堡藝穗節上的一齣個人秀，喜劇演員 Spencer Jones 這次的主題是狗。表演從聊觀眾養的狗開始，最後導向一個關於社會凝聚的訊息——原來寵物也能幫我們在紛擾的時代裡，好好跟彼此說話。
